scene.observations: A person throws a crumpled paper in front of a green chalkboard grid and the paper follows a projectile arc from right to left then down.

agent.message: The crumpled paper flies like a tossed projectile pulled downward by gravity while being slowed by air resistance that grows in direct proportion to its speed. The fitted damping rate of about 2.4 per second means its velocity decays with a characteristic time of under half a second, which strongly outperformed drag-free or speed-squared drag models. Since the video has no size reference, distances and the effective gravity value are only relative, but this damping rate is scale-independent and reliably forecasts the trajectory.
agent.reasoning_summary: Verdict is accepted for linear drag with large BIC margin over quadratic drag and free fall and low hold-out error. Scale is none so lengths/g are arbitrary and only the 1/s damping is exact. Provide concise physical interpretation without quoting scale-dependent quantities.
